description: Shared test vector for the App Assistant preview session-host label. Label = 's' + unpadded lowercase RFC 4648 base32 of 38 bytes: [0] (version << 4) | kid, version 1; [1..16] preview id (16 bytes); [17..21] user id (40-bit big-endian); [22..25] exp (uint32 big-endian Unix seconds); [26..37] HMAC-SHA256(K[kid], 'sandbox-preview:v1:' || bytes 0..25) truncated to 12 bytes. A label is valid only if re-encoding its decoded bytes reproduces it exactly (no spare bit, no upper case), its kid is in the accepted key set, its MAC matches, and now < exp. A copy of the preview gateway's own vector: every field but this description is byte-identical to it; never edit one without the other. TEST-ONLY keys.
